fact: Chief Minister Sengeh said the National Investment Board's One-Stop Digital Business Service Platform, built through a joint venture, is nearly complete and expected to be operational by November 2026, cutting business registration from about 24 hours to minutes.
Parliament ratified a 15-year build-operate-transfer concession under which Multi GIS E-Services SL Ltd will develop, operate and maintain the Online Business Registration System, per Sierraloaded.
The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation says the launched WanGov app offers businesses services including business registration.
